title: ProTTS: End-to-End Prominence-aware Natural and Controllable Text-to-Speech via Automatic Word Stress Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.19832v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Natural speech conveys meaning not only through words, but also through the prominence on a few words. Yet most text-to-speech (TTS) systems remain prominence-unaware, existing prominence-aware TTS require external stress annotations, while unsupervised stress detectors operate in isolation, disconnected from synthesis. This creates a fundamental gap no existing system can automatically discover where stress should be placed, realize it as natural-sounding prosody, and offer user control over emphasis placement, all within a single model. To circumvent this, we propose ProTTS, a unified framework where stress detection emerges from the TTS model itself and, in turn, guides it to synthesize more natural and controllable speech. translated_title: ProTTS：通过自动词重音发现实现端到端的重音感知、自然且可控的文本转语音
translated_abstract: 自然语音不仅通过词语本身传递意义，还通过少数词语上所承载的重音传递意义。然而，大多数文本转语音（TTS）系统仍然不感知重音：现有的重音感知TTS需要外部的重音标注，而无监督重音检测器则独立运行，与语音合成过程脱节。这造成了一个根本性的空白——目前没有任何系统能够在单一模型内自动发现重音应该落在哪些词上、将其实现为听感自然的韵律，并同时为用户提供对强调位置的控制。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ProTTS，这是一个统一框架：重音检测由TTS模型自身产生，并反过来引导模型合成更自然、更可控的语音。我们在FastSpeech 2的方差适配器中引入了一个聚类头，直接从聚合的韵律特征中发现词重音。所发现的重音随后驱动强调方差预测器……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出ProTTS统一框架，在单一TTS模型内通过聚类头自动发现词重音并引导合成，实现了无需外部重音标注、自然且用户可控的强调语音生成。
en_tdlr: ProTTS is a unified end-to-end TTS framework that automatically discovers word stress via a clustering head inside the model itself, enabling natural-sounding and user-controllable emphasis without external stress annotations.
